scope: Smooth, everywhere minimal elliptic K3 fibrations with a chosen zero section, up to base automorphisms
key_namespace: Keys decoded by FibrationFromKeyF2 in this repository

csv.polynomials: space-separated integer coefficients, constant term first
csv.fibres: degree:conductor:tamagawa:Kodaira; sorted by degree, Kodaira, conductor, tamagawa

key_map.collaborator_key: Key decoded by FibrationFromKeyF2 in this repository; used in census.csv
key_map.package_key: Key for the same orbit in edgarcosta/census_elliptic_fibrations
key_map.source: existing for an older census row; missing for a previously absent row
key_map.unhandled: Blank for existing rows; 0 or 1 for missing rows, preserving the flag from the missing-key map supplied by Elise; that input map is not included here

provenance.computation: Saved full F_2 calculation produced by code from edgarcosta/census_elliptic_fibrations, 371 input shards; no arithmetic recomputation for this export
provenance.program_inputs: Programs retain paths to the saved calculation and auxiliary input files, which are not included in this release

validation.independent_review: All published F_2 census table rows and k3-f2 site rows agree; all missing keys agree with an independent orbit map; 6292 sampled native records agree field for field
validation.magma_sample: 500 missing surfaces checked from package keys; a separate sample of 240 missing surfaces checked from census keys decoded by FibrationFromKeyF2, including 40 unhandled keys
validation.derived_checks: All 148029 missing rows pass P2-derived field checks, component-factor shape and degree checks; all 1397598 rows pass the fibre Euler-number check

limitations: Arithmetic was independently recomputed on samples, not on every newly included row.
Missing rows' P2 factors from reducible fibres rely only on the saved calculation. Structural and derived-field checks do not independently recompute them.
